item.tib: drag sngags gsang ba'i spu gri las gsang phur sgrub pa'i gter gzhung
item.coloph: ces pa'i skyabs sems gsol 'debs 'di ni grogs dbang mo dang g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor/ gshen dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa gsang sngags gling pas bris pa'o// ces pa stag la'i gsang phur 'di ni a bse brag dkar tshe dbang rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gnas nas gsang sngags gling pa'i (pas) zab gter rin po che spyan drangs nas/ phyis su gter grogs dbang gi sgron ma dang*/ mchog sprul g.yung drung khyad par spyi phud nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi (gyis) yang yang nan bskul bgyis pas shing pho stag gi lor dag pa phab pas bstan pa rin po che mkha' ru rgyas par gyur cig/
